sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.457 of 2024 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C. (Rural)(Cog.), Berhampur, Dist-Ganjam, arising out of Gopalpur P.S. Case No.111 of 2024 for commission of offence alleged under Sections 420/506 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner relating to the aforementioned P.S. case is pending in any other Court.

4. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned ADJ- cum-Spl. Judge (V), Berhampur by order dated 18.04.2024 in the aforementioned cases, the present BLAPL has been filed.

5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 21.03.2024 and the allegation against him is that he duped the informant to the tune of Rs.18,16,250/- (Rupees Eighteen Lakhs Sixteen Thousand Two Hundred Fifty) for providing a job.

6. During the course of submission, an affidavit has been filed at the behest of the Petitioner indicating that without prejudice to the rights and contentions, Petitioner is prepared to deposit a sum of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs) as a condition precedent for release and thereafter, the balance amount to be deposited in shape of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand) per month in equal installments.
The first date of such installments shall fall due after two month of such release.

7. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail notwithstanding filing of the charge sheet on 11.06.2024, inter alia, on the ground that the Petitioner has three criminal antecedents of similar nature.

8. Considering the nature of allegations, the filing of the charge sheet and the undertaking, as noted,
this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.

9. Before releasing, the Petitioner shall deposit Rs.2,00,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs), as undertaken and the balance amount shall be deposited in monthly installments of Rs.50,000/- (Fifty Thousand)
to be calculated by the learned Court in seisin and the first date of installment shall fall due after two month of such release, which shall be fixed by the Learned Court in seisin.
10. The amount, as deposited, shall be kept in an interest bearing account which shall abide by the final outcome of the case at hand.
11. In case of any default in the matter of payment of monthly installments, as directed, it shall be open for the learned Court in seisin to take necessary action in accordance with law.

12. Additionally, it is directed that the Petitioner shall appear before the jurisdictional police station once every fortnight on such date and time to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin for the next three months and thereafter, once in three months till conclusion of trial.
Certification of such appearance shall be submitted to the Court in seisin.

13. It is needless to state here that the observations made herein are only for the purpose of consideration of this bail application and the direction to deposit, on the basis of undertaking as noted, ought not to be constructed as this Court expressing any view regarding the complicity of the Petitioners which has to be established in an independent manner in the ongoing trial on the basis of materials on record.
14. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
15. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per the rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Designation: Senior Stenographer Location: High Court of Orissa Date: 09-Oct-2024 12:25:03
